description: POST /v1/fleet/plugins/upload?name=<file>.whl (201): a wheel's bytes kept for an inspect or install: `source` is what to send them, until `expires_at` (milliseconds); 400 without a wheel name or with an empty body, 413 over 32 MiB, 415 without Content-Type application/octet-stream, 422 bad_wheel when the bytes are no zip
